title: Prisoner's text
rule: All text uses only letters without ascenders or descenders (a c e m n o r s u v w x z), lines included.
declares: lines rewritten in the restricted letters
build: films/swarm/99-ways/build/p62_prisoner.py (one-pen kit: build/p51_pen_alone.py; figure model build/b1m2.py)
made: seven panels drawn with page 51's one-pen kit (the folio's pen, 4.42 px, hidden lines lifted) from the b1m2 figure model on the LoC 1934 sheet: desk and memo, walk past the closed cupboard, the lady at a blank-boarded ticket window, the wall clock at 4:10, her leaving, the cupboard opened with the key on its screw and its tag, the forgetting before the SERVICE door
all lettering in the shared pen hand, lowercase only, from the thirteen x-height letters; an epigraph strip 'a c e m n o r s u v w x z' states the alphabet
what the letters cannot spell is DRAWN inline with the same pen as small pictures set into the lines: a clock face at 4:15 (memo) and 4:10 (answer, caption), a key (memo, captions)
every string asserted at build time against the thirteen letters plus non-letter punctuation (check())

question.canon: Pardon me — have you the right time?
question.page: excuse me — can one measure now?

answer.canon: Ten past four, by the clock.
answer.page: now? [drawn clock at 4:10] — as near as one can measure.

forgetting.canon: Well, here I am... and what for?
forgetting.page: so... now, near a case... ...ummm... a reason...?

page_strings: a c e m n o r s u v w x z
so, across a room — on, on...
now a woman, over a screen,
a {key} on a screw, as ever.

events.E0: P1 'our man sees a memo:' memo on the desk; P2 'so, across a room — on, on...'
events.E1: P3 'now a woman, over a screen, summons our man:' + question
events.E2: P4 'our man scans a [clock]:' + answer with drawn 4:10 clock; the wall clock at 4:10
events.E3: P5 'a woman, ever so warm, moves on. no more.' + thanks
events.E4: P6 'our man uncovers a case: a [key] on a screw — annex.'
events.E5: P7 forgetting line; 'a [key] on a screw, as ever. annex: secure as ever.'; door card 'annex'

beat: the page is written and drawn panel by panel in the one pen; the case is drawn shut, then uncovered; the forgetting written last
beat_frames: b01: frames and the alphabet strip
b06: panel 6 with the case shut
b07: panel 7 without the line (case open in 6)
b08: the forgetting balloon (= the page)

self_check.check: Outside the folio line, no letter with an ascender or descender appears: measured (all page strings pass check(); no capitals, digits, i, j or t; the pen hand's glyphs for the 13 letters span y 0..0.62 cap); the drawings carry no lettering
self_check.non_letters_used: . , : - — ... ? ! (punctuation kept; '?' and '!' rise above x-height but are not letters)
self_check.pending: independent blind reading not run by the maker

weaknesses: the rewritten question 'can one measure now?' is oblique; the clock in the next panel carries most of its meaning
'o, ever so, ever so!' as thanks leans on the caption ('ever so warm')
SERVICE becomes 'annex' everywhere, so the door's name changes
'?' and '!' are taller than the x-height; they are kept as non-letters
